{{Quote|So it was him [Darth Wredd]. He must have killed the Sith who infiltrated our legation on Ceitia Five as well.|[[Emperor/Legends|Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]]|<ref name="L6">[[Legacy (2013) 6|''Legacy'' (2013) 6]]</ref>}}
'''Ceitia Five''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[138 ABY]], [[Darth Wredd]] attacked and killed a [[Unidentified One Sith member|One Sith member]] who had infiltrated the legislature of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] on the planet.<ref name="L6" />
